name: Creator palettes
description: The pattern and marking colours your palettes add (palette.json, slots from 25 up) and their coat presets as choices in the cat maker's colour pickers, a palette at a time in a row under the game's. Ten themed palettes and twelve coat presets come with it. Needs wcmods 0.2.0 or newer (coat presets: 0.4.0), UE4SS, and mods that run code allowed.
